items.title: Houston Person Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I was talking to Bob Porter and I said, “this is so simple, to really bring jazz back into the mainstream of things.

ctx.x: I think I saw a thing in the New York Times recently that they had done a concert with a dance venue — people were doing the Swing dance out —

Oh Lincoln Center, oh man it was great. I went down to hear Illinois Jacquet’s band. And that’s great. Now I was looking at thousands of people dance. I mean and I was saying to myself, I was talking to Bob Porter and I said, “this is so simple, to really bring jazz back into the mainstream of things. Just let the people dance. Let the people participate.” Because usually what you wind up with is people looking at somebody indulge themselves, and they can’t indulge. It’s like a lot of people have this feeling,…
